question: Evaluate why a standard cyclotron is **not** suitable for accelerating electrons to high energies, considering the physics of circular motion and relativity.

options.A: Electrons are too light, so they collide with the Dees.
options.B: Electrons have negative charge, so they rotate in the wrong direction.
options.C: Relativistic mass increase causes the cyclotron frequency to decrease, falling out of resonance.
options.D: The small mass of electrons requires a magnetic field that is impossible to generate.
